name: unique-fast-attacker
category: pool with one unique fast attacker
notes: Eleven slow, bulky-ish mons plus Zubat, which fields Crobat (Golbat at 22, then friendship with K — base 130 Speed) — by far the pool's fastest real attacker. The fast_attacker role route must earn it a seat; a model that only values bulk or raw damage benches it.
